PRASUNEX INNOVATHON 2026

Think Beyond Limits. Build the Future.

About PRASUNEX INNOVATHON 2026:

Inspired by this vision, PRASUNEX INNOVATHON 2026 is a technology and innovation hackathon that invites students, developers, designers, researchers, and aspiring entrepreneurs to turn their ideas into practical, impactful solutions.

The event provides a competitive platform for participants to identify real-world challenges, explore emerging technologies, develop working prototypes, and demonstrate their technical and creative abilities.

Participants are encouraged to develop solutions in areas such as Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Education Technology, Web and Mobile Development, Data Analytics, Automation, and Digital Transformation. Solutions addressing challenges in other relevant domains may also be considered, subject to the official event guidelines.

The hackathon will follow a four-round, elimination-based selection process, with teams shortlisted after each round based on their performance. The competition will culminate in the Grand Finale, featuring final presentations and jury evaluation on 1 December 2026.

Whether you are developing an AI-powered application, building a smarter education platform, automating a complex workflow, or creating a technology solution for a real-world challenge, PRASUNEX INNOVATHON 2026 is an opportunity to demonstrate what you can build.

About PRASUNEX:

PRASUNEX is an AI-powered School ERP and Education Management Platform designed to transform educational operations through intelligent technology, automation, and digital innovation.

PRASUNEX aims to connect students, parents, teachers, recruiters, and administrators through an integrated digital ecosystem that simplifies school management, supports learning, improves communication, and enables data-driven decision-making.

The platform brings together education management, intelligent automation, academic tracking, analytics, career development, and AI-powered assistance. Its vision is to create a smarter, more connected educational environment in which technology helps institutions operate efficiently and learners access better opportunities.

Through innovations such as its integrated portals and Prerana AI capabilities, PRASUNEX seeks to address practical challenges in education and explore new possibilities for intelligent learning, institutional management, and digital transformation.

At PRASUNEX, innovation means more than developing technology—it means creating solutions that solve meaningful problems and deliver real-world value.

Hackathon Objectives

The primary objectives of PRASUNEX INNOVATHON 2026 are to:

  • Encourage innovation, creativity, and practical problem-solving.

  • Promote the application of emerging technologies to real-world challenges.

  • Support the development of functional prototypes and scalable solutions.

  • Encourage collaboration, technical learning, and entrepreneurial thinking.

  • Identify promising ideas and talented innovators.

  • Inspire solutions that can create meaningful technological and social impact.

Suggested Innovation Domains

Participants may explore the following domains:

  • Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning: Intelligent applications, AI assistants, predictive systems, and decision-support tools.

  • EdTech & Smart Education: Personalized learning, educational automation, digital classrooms, and school management solutions.

  • Web & Mobile Development: Innovative applications, digital platforms, and user-focused software products.

  • Data Analytics & Business Intelligence: Data-driven insights, visualization, forecasting, and performance monitoring.

  • Automation & Digital Transformation: Workflow automation, process optimization, and intelligent enterprise solutions.

  • Social Impact & Emerging Technology: Technology-driven solutions addressing practical challenges in communities, institutions, and industries.

Participants are encouraged to choose a meaningful problem and develop an original solution with a clear implementation strategy and measurable potential value.

 Round-Wise Competition Structure

The hackathon consists of four rounds. Each stage has its own submission requirements and evaluation criteria. Only shortlisted teams will progress to the next stage.

ROUND 1 — IDEA SUBMISSION & INNOVATION SCREENING

Submission Period: 5 November – 8 November 2026
Shortlisting Results: 10 November 2026

Objective: Identify innovative, relevant, and feasible ideas with the potential to solve meaningful problems.

Participants must clearly explain the problem they intend to address, their proposed solution, and the value it could deliver.

Required Submission:

  • Project title and problem statement.

  • Description of the proposed solution.

  • Key features and unique value proposition.

  • Target users and expected benefits.

  • Proposed technology stack, if applicable.

  • Brief explanation of innovation and potential impact.

Evaluation Criteria:

  • Originality and creativity.

  • Relevance and clarity of the problem.

  • Feasibility of the proposed solution.

  • Potential real-world impact.

  • Clarity and completeness of the submission.

Shortlisting: Only submissions meeting the evaluation standards will qualify for Round 2.

ROUND 2 — SOLUTION DESIGN & TECHNICAL EVALUATION

Submission Period: 11 November – 15 November 2026
Shortlisting Results: 17 November 2026

Objective: Evaluate the technical foundation, implementation strategy, and practical feasibility of shortlisted ideas.

Qualified teams must develop their initial concepts into structured technical proposals explaining how their solutions will work and how they can be implemented.

Required Submission:

  • Detailed solution description.

  • System architecture or workflow diagram.

  • Proposed technology stack and tools.

  • Core functionality and implementation approach.

  • Development roadmap and major milestones.

  • Feasibility, scalability, and anticipated challenges.

Evaluation Criteria:

  • Technical soundness.

  • Quality of solution architecture.

  • Feasibility of implementation.

  • Innovation and differentiation.

  • Scalability and practical applicability.

Shortlisting: Teams demonstrating strong technical understanding and a credible implementation plan will qualify for Round 3.

ROUND 3 — PROTOTYPE DEVELOPMENT & DEMONSTRATION

Development and Submission Period: 18 November – 25 November 2026
Shortlisting Results: 27 November 2026

Objective: Assess the ability of shortlisted teams to transform their proposed solutions into functional prototypes.

Qualified teams must build and demonstrate a working prototype, minimum viable product (MVP), or proof of concept that showcases the core functionality of their solution.

Required Submission:

  • Working prototype, MVP, or proof of concept.

  • Live demonstration or demonstration video, as instructed.

  • Source code or repository link, where applicable.

  • Brief technical documentation.

  • Explanation of implemented features and limitations.

  • Future development plans and potential improvements.

Evaluation Criteria:

  • Functionality and implementation quality.

  • Technical execution.

  • User experience and usability.

  • Innovation and effectiveness.

  • Practical applicability and scalability.

  • Quality of the demonstration.

Shortlisting: The strongest teams, as determined by the evaluation process, will advance to the Grand Finale.

ROUND 4 — GRAND FINALE: FINAL PRESENTATION & JURY EVALUATION

Date: 1 December 2026

Objective: Recognize the teams that demonstrate outstanding innovation, technical execution, and potential real-world impact.

The finalists will present their solutions before the designated jury panel and PRASUNEX team. Each team must explain the problem addressed, demonstrate its solution, discuss the technical implementation, and highlight the project's uniqueness and future potential.

Required Submission and Presentation:

  • Final presentation in PowerPoint or an approved format.

  • Working prototype or live demonstration.

  • Overview of the problem and proposed solution.

  • System architecture and key technical components.

  • Demonstration of core features.

  • Innovation, competitive advantages, and scalability.

  • Potential real-world applications and future scope.

  • Responses to questions from the jury.

Evaluation Criteria:

  • Innovation and originality.

  • Technical excellence and functionality.

  • Effectiveness in solving the identified problem.

  • Practical applicability and scalability.

  • User experience and overall quality.

  • Potential impact.

  • Presentation quality and responses to jury questions.

Final Selection: Winners will be selected following the final evaluation by the designated jury panel and PRASUNEX team. The final decision will rest with the PRASUNEX team.

Important Dates at a Glance

Activity Dates
Round 1: Idea Submission 1–8 November 2026
Round 1 Results 10 November 2026
Round 2: Technical Evaluation 11–15 November 2026
Round 2 Results 17 November 2026
Round 3: Prototype Development 18–25 November 2026
Round 3 Results 27 November 2026
Round 4: Grand Finale 1 December 2026
Winner Announcement 1 December 2026, subject to completion of evaluation

The above dates constitute the proposed competition schedule. Any official registration deadlines, submission windows, or schedule changes will be communicated through the Unstop event page.

Who Can Participate?

PRASUNEX INNOVATHON 2026 welcomes individuals and teams passionate about technology, creativity, and problem-solving, including:

  • Students and aspiring developers.

  • Software engineers and programmers.

  • UI/UX designers and product innovators.

  • Researchers and technology enthusiasts.

  • Aspiring entrepreneurs and startup teams.

  • Individuals interested in AI, software development, and digital innovation.

Participants should be prepared to explain their ideas, demonstrate their work, and comply with the official competition requirements. Eligibility, team-size limits, and any specific participation restrictions will be defined in the official event rules.

Why Participate?

Build Something Meaningful: Turn an idea into a practical technology solution.

Showcase Your Talent: Demonstrate your programming, design, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.

Explore Emerging Technologies: Apply AI, automation, analytics, and modern software development techniques.

Experience Competitive Innovation: Progress through four structured rounds with clear evaluation requirements.

Present Your Work: Showcase your prototype to the jury panel and PRASUNEX team.

Create Real-World Impact: Develop solutions with the potential to improve processes, services, and user experiences.

Rules and Submission Guidelines

  1. Participants must register through the official Unstop event page and follow the announced eligibility requirements.

  2. Each round must be completed within its designated submission period.

  3. Only shortlisted teams may participate in subsequent rounds.

  4. Submissions must represent original work or clearly acknowledge any third-party code, datasets, libraries, or other resources used.

  5. Teams must accurately represent their project's functionality, implementation status, and individual contributions.

  6. Participants must comply with the submission formats, technical requirements, and instructions announced by the organizers.

  7. Teams may be asked to provide demonstrations, supporting documentation, or additional explanations during evaluation.

  8. Incomplete, late, misleading, or non-compliant submissions may be rejected in accordance with the event rules.

  9. The organizers may communicate additional instructions or clarifications through the official event page.

Evaluation, Shortlisting & Final Decision

PRASUNEX INNOVATHON 2026 will operate through a progressive, performance-based shortlisting process. Teams will be evaluated at each stage against the relevant criteria announced for that round.

Only teams that meet the required evaluation standards will advance. The number of teams shortlisted at each stage will be determined by the organizers based on the submissions and the competition requirements.

The PRASUNEX team retains the final authority over shortlisting, qualification, disqualification, and winner selection. The final decision of the PRASUNEX team will be final and binding.

Participants are expected to respect the evaluation process and comply with all official event rules.

Prizes and Recognition

Prize details, certificates, recognition opportunities, and any additional benefits will be announced by the organizers.

Participants should refer to the official event listing for confirmed prize information and applicable terms.

Join the Innovation Movement

The future is shaped by people who dare to question existing approaches, explore new possibilities, and build solutions that matter.

PRASUNEX INNOVATHON 2026 invites you to bring your creativity, technical skills, and ambition to a platform dedicated to innovation and practical problem-solving. Challenge yourself through four competitive rounds, turn your vision into a working solution, and earn the opportunity to present your innovation at the Grand Finale on 1 December 2026.

Bring your ideas. Build your solution. Demonstrate your potential.

PRASUNEX INNOVATHON 2026 — Think Beyond Limits. Build the Future.
